description: This PHP source file defines the 'Identifier' controller class for the OpenCart admin module's localisation identifiers management. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting localisation identifiers, with integration to models, views, and handling of user permissions.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation identifiers, providing CRUD operations and user interface rendering for the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial display of the identifiers list page, setting up breadcrumbs, titles, and loading the main view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve the list of identifiers.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of identifiers from the model and renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an identifier, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to add or update an identifier, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected identifiers after permission validation.
